description: Research data: raw geochemistry (assay samples) around a point. Per element and per sample type (STREA stream-sed, ROCKC rock-chip, DRILL, SHALL, SOIL) returns concentration stats (n, min, p50, p90, max, mean, in ppm) plus the top anomalies (highest-value samples with coordinates) for the primary element. Pass raw=true to get the full per-sample arrays when the neighbourhood is small enough.

elements.description: Subset of Cu, Au, Mo, Ag, Pb, Zn, Co, Bi, Ni, W, As, Sn, Cr, Sb (default Au, Cu, As). The first is the 'primary' for anomaly ranking.

raw.description: Return full per-sample arrays if n <= 500.

sample_types.description: Subset of STREA, ROCKC, DRILL, SHALL, SOIL (default all).

name: get_geochem
title: Get geochemistry near a point
